definition_en: a structure built over a river or road so people can cross
scene: 一座石桥横跨在河面上。A stone bridge crossed the narrow river.
sceneCN: 这里 bridge 是「桥」（第 1 个义项：架在水面或道路上供人通过的建筑）；句意是一座石桥横跨在窄河上。

senses.title: A structure for crossing
senses.definition: a structure built over a river or road so people can cross
senses.definitionCN: 架在水面或道路上方供人通过的建筑
senses.example: A stone bridge crossed the narrow river.
senses.exampleCN: 一座石桥横跨在窄河上。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from building.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自建筑。

senses.title: Something that links two sides
senses.definition: something that connects two separate things
senses.definitionCN: 把两个分开的事物连起来的东西
senses.example: Music is a bridge between cultures.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐是文化之间的桥梁。
senses.why: A bridge over water pictured a link between people.
senses.whyCN: 水面上的桥被用来比喻人与人之间的联系。

senses.title: To reduce a difference
senses.definition: to reduce or remove a difference
senses.example: The talks aimed to bridge the gap.
senses.why: Crossing a bridge became closing a distance.
senses.whyCN: 过桥的动作变成了消除距离。

intro.en: Bridge is an Old English word for a crossing over water.
intro.cn: bridge 是古英语中表示水上通道的词。

items.en: brycg named a crossing over a river.
bridge also named the card game.
bridge meant a link between things.
items.cn: bridge 指事物之间的联系。

items.en: bridge covers crossings, links and closing gaps.
items.cn: 如今 bridge 兼指桥、纽带与弥合差距。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the br- or -idge shape; the near-meaning group gives other linking words.
note.cn: 形近组共用 br- 或 -idge 的外形；近义组是表示连接的词。

entries.definition: a cold box for keeping food
a long narrow top of a hill

normalIntro.en: Bridge carries people over water and carries ideas between people.
normalIntro.cn: bridge 把人送过水面，也把想法在人与人之间传递。

normal.en: A stone bridge spans the river.

normal.cn: burn one's bridges 指断了交情。

abstract.en: See an arch over moving water.
abstract.cn: 想象流水上方的一道拱。

abstract.en: See two banks joined by stone.
abstract.cn: 想象石头把两岸连起来。

abstract.en: See two people reaching across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人隔着桌子伸手相握。

examples.en: A stone bridge crossed the narrow river.
examples.cn: 一座石桥横跨在窄河上。

examples.en: Music is a bridge between cultures.
examples.cn: 音乐是文化之间的桥梁。

examples.en: The talks aimed to bridge the gap.

dict_mnemonic.text: bridge 里有 rid，像「立得住」的桥墩，ge 是桥面的回声，一座桥把两岸连起来。

root: bridge 源自古英语 brycg，本指跨越水面的通道，中古英语保留建筑义，十六世纪起也指桥牌，十九世纪引申为事物之间的纽带与弥合差距的动作。

sensesIntro.en: A crossing over water, a link between things and the act of closing a gap.
sensesIntro.cn: 跨越水面的通道、事物之间的纽带、缩小差距的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone arch over a narrow river.
core.cn: 核心意象：横跨窄河的石拱。

intro.en: Bridge forms nouns with -ing and head.
intro.cn: bridge 加 -ing 并与 head 构成名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Old English; the Latin items below are related only in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自古英语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

items.meaning: a position held across a river
to go from one side to the other
